name: task-management
description: Codex workflow skill for backend-neutral task management; Hermes also receives a native read-only task tool.

interface.longDescription: Provides Codex with one workflow skill for backend-neutral task drafting, review preparation, and routing. The separate Hermes native manifest registers the read-only task_query runtime tool. This Codex manifest does not claim an MCP server because the package does not bundle one.
defaultPrompt: Use task-management to turn this note into a reviewed task draft.
Use task-management to prepare a task routing preview.
Use task-management to check task backend boundaries.
